title: Verrucous
summary: VER'RUCOUS, adjective [Latin verruca, a wart; verrucosus, full of warts.] Warty; having little knobs or warts on the surface; as a verrucous capsule.

inlines.v: VER'RUCOUS, adjective [Latin verruca, a wart; verrucosus, full of warts.] Warty; having little knobs or warts on the surface; as a verrucous capsule.
